# Pull request

## Description

Explain the contributor or agent workflow this change improves. Link the
related issue or Microsoft Learn article when applicable.

## Changes

Describe the files and behavior changed.

## How to test

List the exact commands or manual checks used. If the generated app requires
Azure configuration, name the required environment variables and confirm that
only placeholders are committed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed `AGENTS.md` and the Azure Cosmos DB Agent Kit guidance.
- [ ] I kept generated code focused on the source article or request.
- [ ] I used placeholders or environment variables for configuration.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, tokens, connection strings, or production identifiers.
- [ ] I restored dependencies and built the generated app, when the change includes one.
- [ ] I ran the app when it was safe to do so, or documented the required configuration.
- [ ] I updated related guidance and `CHANGELOG.md` when contributor behavior changed.
